context:
Goal: each repo's page is usable live and rebuildable anywhere, with git as the dataset.
Problem (rule): as built on main, the page writes answers only to its claude.ai database, and the writer copies it to git at each wake, so git lags; page.html reads only the database and shows "This view cannot reach the page's store" without it. #2829 (from your item 593 a, 12:40 CST Nov 12) makes the database the truth and git a timely backup. Your 12:03 CST words today ("nothing points to a specific link of the artifact as the real dataset, only git data in a sense") and R28 (11:50 CST Nov 11) point the other way.
Based on (ruling): R28; item 593 a; your 12:03 CST Nov 13 words.
Departs from: main — the database is the store and git is copied at each wake; a makes git the truth.
Meanwhile: the coordinator gave batch 136, which holds #2829, a go at 12:05 CST; the retrospective asks that #2829 stay a draft until you answer.
home: PR #2829; rulings R28 and item 593 a

options.gain: Rebuildable anywhere, cross-account reads need nothing special, no stale copy.
options.how: Each answer is written to git at once or within the turn; the page builds from git and the database is the live cache.
options.label: Git is the truth; every page write also lands in git (recommended)
options.lose: Every answer costs a git write.

options.how: The page keeps writing only to its database; git is copied at each wake.
options.label: Keep #2829: the database first, git a timely backup
options.lose: Git lags, and the Questions tab cannot render from git.

title: Should git be the truth for each page, with the database a live cache, instead of #2829's database-first model?
why: Your 593 a and your 12:03 CST words point different ways; the retrospective asks you to pick.
